user_story: As a user, I want to create a task with a title so that I can track my work.

positive.title: Create a task with a valid title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a valid title in the title input field.
positive.expected_result: The task is created successfully and is displayed in the task list with the correct title.

negative.title: Attempt to create a task with an empty title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Leave the title input field empty.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title is required, and the task is not created.

edge.title: Create a task with a very long title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a title that exceeds the maximum character limit (e.g., 256 characters).
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title exceeds the maximum allowed length, and the task is not created.
